svg.text: Four electrovores + three stones • one-inch bases
Fold both faces around the top spine.
Keep the two bottom feet free.
Fold the feet in opposite directions.
Glue feet along the base centerline.
The artwork and number appear on both sides. The board base adds weight for handling.
Top spine: 0.08 in / about 2 mm. Designed around your 1.5 mm board plus paper and glue.
Make one pawn first to check the fit. Use thinner card for the upright core if the faces bow outward.
